{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Nursing & Health Innovation at Arizona State University.
We offer several pathways for students to earn their Bachelors of Science in Nursing (BSN). For a new freshman student, the most conventional pathway would be the Traditional Prelicensure Clinical Nursing Program (TPCNP) located at ASU’s Downtown Phoenix campus. The TPCNP is a four-year program culminating in a Bachelor’s of Science in Nursing. Students take nursing prerequisite courses for their first two years and then advance into the upper division clinical nursing program for their junior and senior year.
Like many nursing programs across the country, space is limited in our clinical nursing program. Typically, we have a minimum of 180 available seats each year in the upper division clinical nursing program. Students can move into the upper division program through one of two ways:
Direct Admission: First time freshman applicants are considered for direct admission based on high school GPA or class rank and performance on either the SAT or ACT. You can read more about the specific admission requirements for incoming freshmen online. Students who earn direct admission into the nursing major are guaranteed a space in the upper division clinical nursing program so long as they meet the minimum progression requirements in their first two years at ASU.
Competitive Application Process: Students who do not qualify for direct admission are initially admitted to our Community Health major, which mirrors the first two years of the nursing curriculum. These students complete nursing prerequisite coursework at ASU and then apply to the upper division nursing program through a competitive application process. Decisions are based upon the applicant's prerequisite GPA and test score on the Test of Essential Academic Skills (TEAS).
If you wish to learn more about our programs, please explore the following options and resources:
View the online BSN Information Session for the Traditional Prelicensure Clinical Nursing Program.
Register for a campus visit and nursing information session.
If you are ready to join the Sun Devil community, you will need to apply for admission to ASU. If you have not done so already, you will need to take the ACT or SAT to be eligible for Direct Admission to nursing.
If you have additional questions, please reply to this email or call our office at 602-496-0937, and we will be glad to help.
Sincerely,
